circuit.name: 3-Level NPC (Closed-Loop AC Inverter via PD PWM)
circuit.description: Single-phase three-level Neutral Point Clamped (NPC) inverter with closed-loop AC voltage regulation via Phase Disposition (PD) PWM and continuous-time PI control with voltage feed-forward. Converts a stiff 1000V split-rail DC link (two 500V rails anchored at midpoint neutral n6) to a clean 400V peak 50Hz sinusoidal AC output across a 1.6 Ohm load. Four NMOS switches (SW1-SW4) and two clamping diodes (D_CLAMP_P, D_CLAMP_N) produce three voltage levels (+500V, 0V, -500V) at switch node n5 relative to midpoint n6, with 10kHz carrier triangle modulation and 500ns interlocking dead-time delay.
models: * Removed Tt from models to prevent infinite di/dt matrix singularities during hard switching
.model SCTHC250N120G_NMOS NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=14.706 Cbd=0.6n Cbs=0.6n Cgdo=0.6n Is=1e-14 Rs=0.0085)
.model Dmodel D(Is=1e-12 n=1.1 Rs=0.001 Cjo=5e-11 Bv=750 Ibv=1e-06)

params.spice_line: * CRITICAL FIX: Anchor the NPC midpoint to control ground to prevent floating matrix singularities
* Error calculation (Reference - Actual Load Voltage relative to midpoint)
* Control Effort: PI Output + Voltage Feed-forward (normalized to +/- 1)
* Smooth PWM Generation (Phase Disposition) with 500ns Dead-Time
* 10kHz Carrier slope is 20,000 V/s. A 0.01V offset mathematically creates a robust 500ns interlocking delay.

circuit.name: 3-Level NPC (Closed-Loop AC Inverter via PD PWM)
circuit.description: Single-phase three-level Neutral Point Clamped (NPC) inverter with closed-loop AC voltage regulation via Phase Disposition (PD) PWM and continuous-time PI control with voltage feed-forward. Converts a stiff 1000V split-rail DC link (two 500V rails anchored at midpoint neutral n6) to a clean 400V peak 50Hz sinusoidal AC output across a 1.6 Ohm load. Four NMOS switches (SW1-SW4) and two clamping diodes (D_CLAMP_P, D_CLAMP_N) produce three voltage levels (+500V, 0V, -500V) at switch node n5 relative to midpoint n6, with 10kHz carrier triangle modulation and 500ns interlocking dead-time delay.
models: * Removed Tt from models to prevent infinite di/dt matrix singularities during hard switching
.model SCTHC250N120G_NMOS NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=14.706 Cbd=0.6n Cbs=0.6n Cgdo=0.6n Is=1e-14 Rs=0.0085)
.model Dmodel D(Is=1e-12 n=1.1 Rs=0.001 Cjo=5e-11 Bv=750 Ibv=1e-06)

params.spice_line: * CRITICAL FIX: Anchor the NPC midpoint to control ground to prevent floating matrix singularities
* Error calculation (Reference - Actual Load Voltage relative to midpoint)
* Control Effort: PI Output + Voltage Feed-forward (normalized to +/- 1)
* Smooth PWM Generation (Phase Disposition) with 500ns Dead-Time
* 10kHz Carrier slope is 20,000 V/s. A 0.01V offset mathematically creates a robust 500ns interlocking delay.

Converts a stiff 1000V split-rail DC link (two 500V rails anchored at midpoint neutral n6) to a clean 400V peak 50Hz sinusoidal AC output across a 1.6 Ohm load. Four NMOS switches (SW1-SW4) and two clamping diodes (D_CLAMP_P, D_CLAMP_N) produce three voltage levels (+500V, 0V, -500V) at switch node n5 relative to midpoint n6, with 10kHz carrier triangle modulation and 500ns interlocking dead-time delay.
models: * Removed Tt from models to prevent infinite di/dt matrix singularities during hard switching
.model SCTHC250N120G_NMOS NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=14.706 Cbd=0.6n Cbs=0.6n Cgdo=0.6n Is=1e-14 Rs=0.0085)
.model Dmodel D(Is=1e-12 n=1.1 Rs=0.001 Cjo=5e-11 Bv=750 Ibv=1e-06)

params.spice_line: * CRITICAL FIX: Anchor the NPC midpoint to control ground to prevent floating matrix singularities
* Error calculation (Reference - Actual Load Voltage relative to midpoint)
* Control Effort: PI Output + Voltage Feed-forward (normalized to +/- 1)
* Smooth PWM Generation (Phase Disposition) with 500ns Dead-Time
* 10kHz Carrier slope is 20,000 V/s. A 0.01V offset mathematically creates a robust 500ns interlocking delay.
